capabilities: Visualize the vault as a 2D or 3D map of folders, notes and links
Search folders, files and tags by name and fly to results
Inspect node details, link lists and child files from a selection panel
Replay vault history by creation date
disambiguation: Not a mind-mapping or brainstorming editor; it only visualizes the existing vault structure of folders, notes and links.
extras: Makes no network requests; 3D requires WebGL or the map stays in 2D; the export diagnostics command writes diagnostic files containing paths and geometry into the vault and plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to explore the vault's folder hierarchy and links together as a single interactive spatial map with search and fly-to navigation.
summary: Vault visualization that draws folders as branches, notes as leaves and links between them, explorable in 2D or 3D.
